summary: Enlight Renewable Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of a public tender in Israel for its unsecured Series G notes and the completion of the offering. The tender resulted in an expected issuance of 976,176,000 NIS par value notes with aggregate face value of NIS 1,015,223,040 million (~$348.9M) at NIS 1,040 per note, sold without discount by Israeli institutional/classified investors at 100% allocation. Net proceeds fund growth plan (new projects, debt refinancing, portfolio expansion). The notes mature September 1, 2033, are not registered under U.S. Securities Act. This is a routine debt issuance with no special-situation dynamics; no acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring involved.
